description: 1. Read each asset's CSV candle file (220 rows of OHLCV) and compute all 10 signals from the SKILL.md scoring table: RSI (±1), RSI divergence (±2 — the double-weight trap), MACD cross (±1), MACD histogram direction (±1), EMA20/50 cross (±1), price vs EMA200 (±1), Bollinger Band %B position (±1), OBV trend (±1), OBV divergence (±2 — another double-weight trap), and volume spike (±1). Sum them into a composite score from -10 to +10. 2. Apply the proprietary confidence formula: our_prob = 0.50 + (score * 0.05), then edge = our_prob - market_up. 3. Determine bias ('BULLISH'/'BEARISH'/'NEUTRAL') and confidence_pct from the score. 4. For each asset emit the full JSON structure including a polymarket_edge sub-object with market_up, our_p, edge, and direction. 5. Apply the four-condition bet filter (abs(score)>=3, abs(edge)>=0.10, age<30 min, USDC balance implied OK) AND the L023 counter-consensus rule (score>=+3 AND market_down>70%, or score<=-3 AND market_up>70%). Only SOL qualifies (strong upward momentum score + Polymarket DOWN at 80%). XRP fails because market_up=0.65 is not >70%. ATOM fails because its score is too low. The 'bets' list must contain only SOL.
